correctness.rationale: For four labeled agents and four objects, normalization of the first ranking by object permutation is unique, reducing 24^4 labeled preference profiles to exactly 24^3 canonical profiles with multiplicity 24. Enumerating all 24 priority orders within each canonical profile counts the full 24-matching outcome lottery (not marginal probabilities). A NEW separately coded exhaustive Python implementation evaluated all 13,824 canonical profiles, found exactly 57 positive multiplicity signatures and the claimed 16 support sizes; exact rational aggregation gave E[K]=1597/288 and Var(K)=684839/82944. The actual package contains verify.py, independent full-label verify_full.cpp (all 331,776 profiles), verify_pareto.py, spectrum.csv and support tables; verifier source inspected for the full-label approach. Counting is exhaustive over this FINITE domain, not a general-n theorem. K=1 iff all first choices differ by exchanging priority of two agents; K=24 endpoint attested by the exhaustive table, not an asserted general theorem.
